mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates an accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or the rank correlation between FEDFUNDS and 20-day returns is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate exceeding 0.5% signals a tightening monetary policy that increases discount rates for equity valuation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, or the rank correlation between FEDFUNDS and 20-day returns is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high unemployment (UNRATE > 5%) and declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100) indicates a weakening labor market and slowing supply chain, which predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 5% AND INDPRO < 100, or the rank correlation between the interaction and 20-day returns is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (defined by FEDFUNDS > 0.5%), the federal funds rate increase compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, or the rank correlation between FEDFUNDS and 20-day returns is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 700,000 units indicate strong consumer demand and economic expansion, which predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when HOUST > 700, or the rank correlation between HOUST and 60-day returns is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high consumer spending (RSAFS > 400000 million dollars) and strong housing starts (HOUST > 700,000 units) indicates robust consumer demand, which predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when RSAFS > 400000 AND HOUST > 700, or the rank correlation between the interaction and 5-day returns is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 100 (2017=100) indicates a slowing economy and reduced supply chain activity, which predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or the rank correlation between INDPRO and 60-day returns is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate above 5% indicates a weak labor market, which predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 5%, or the rank correlation between UNRATE and 5-day returns is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.
